headerDisplay: UniFi Protect alarm as a HomeKit Security System. Create the API key from a **dedicated, limited UniFi user** (see README), not your owner account.
footerDisplay: Only HomeKit modes that match an arm profile are shown in the Home app. The console certificate is pinned on first connection; check the Homebridge log for its fingerprint.

controller.title: Console IP / Host
controller.description: IP address of your UniFi OS console (preferred over a hostname). Optional :port.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: UniFi OS API key (Settings → Control Plane → Integrations), created while logged in as the limited user.

homeProfileName.title: Home → Profile Name
homeProfileName.description: If no profile has this name, Home is hidden in the Home app (it no longer silently disarms).

certFingerprint.title: Console Certificate SHA-256 Fingerprint
certFingerprint.description: Optional but recommended. If empty, the certificate seen on first connection is pinned automatically.

oneOf.title: Pin console certificate (default; works with UniFi's self-signed cert)
Trusted CA certificate (only if your console has a real certificate for its hostname)
